text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Half-hourly output (faint line) and each day's largest half-hour (dark line), in MW, over the 12-month window. Horizontal lines: the five published capacity values, and two measures of the BMU's own output (P99 and maximum). Dashed: the 99th percentile of output. Dotted: the largest half-hour, which played no part in choosing the BMUs. Text on a line: the values that agree there to one decimal place. An arrow joins each other value to its label. TEC and REPD describe the whole Cleve Hill project, which holds both Cleve Hill BMUs and a battery.'
text.tspan: Half-hourly output (faint line) and each day's largest half-hour (dark line), in MW, over the 12-month window.
Horizontal lines: the five published capacity values, and two measures of the BMU's own output (P99 and maximum).
Dashed: the 99th percentile of output. Dotted: the largest half-hour, which played no part in choosing the BMUs.
Text on a line: the values that agree there to one decimal place. An arrow joins each other value to its label.
TEC and REPD describe the whole Cleve Hill project, which holds both Cleve Hill BMUs and a battery.
